title: Apify Store Scraper Input

categoryNames.title: Category Names
categoryNames.description: Filter by one or more store categories. Leave empty for ALL categories. E.g. 'AI', 'Lead Generation', 'Social Media', 'E-commerce', 'Developer Tools', 'Marketing', 'SEO Tools'.

sortBy.title: Sort By
sortBy.description: Sort order. 'popularity' = most users first (default). 'newest' = recently published. 'lastUpdate' = recently updated. 'totalUsers' = by total user count. 'relevance' = relevance score.

pricingModels.title: Pricing Models
pricingModels.description: Filter by pricing. 'All' = both free and paid. 'FREE' = free actors only. 'PAID' = paid actors only.

maintainedBy.title: Maintained By
maintainedBy.description: 'All Developers' = everyone (default). 'apify' = official Apify-built actors only.

maxItems.title: Max Items
maxItems.description: Max actors to scrape. 0 = all (26,000+ actors). Set a smaller number for a quick sample.

enrichDetails.title: Enrich with Detail Data
enrichDetails.description: VibeLeads scope: keep optional contact/detail extraction explicitly disabled during company discovery. A relevant stage for named qualified businesses requires verified actual build controls, source/use rights and suppression under the contact-use gate. Decline inseparable audience collection.
enrichDetails.x-vibeleads-discovery: explicitly disabled; verify actual build, otherwise decline route

detailConcurrency.title: Detail Fetch Concurrency
detailConcurrency.description: Parallel detail fetches per batch (1–20). Higher = faster. Default: 10.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
